_note: Pug mode follows svelte-check's language lookup on the first top-level <template> tag: `lang`, else `type`, with `text/` stripped, so type="text/pug" drops the diagnostics inside the tag's content and the file's unused-name diagnostics, while a <template lang="pug"> spelled inside an {@html} string does not switch the file to pug. The start tag lies outside the content range, so its attributes still check (svelte-check --tsgo with svelte 5.55 reports a TS2353 on `type` there through the real element typings).
